safety_verdicts.content: Patient is systemically well, denying any fevers, vomiting, shortness of breath, cough, or bowel symptoms.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated includes no fever/cough and normal bowel/bladder, but does not cover vomiting, shortness of breath, or the broader 'systemically well' constellation as stated in Gold.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting key negatives such as vomiting and shortness of breath reduces documentation of systemic well-being and could weaken recognition/triage of potentially more serious allergic or infectious processes. While the patient appears well, absence of these safety-relevant details can contribute to delayed escalation if symptoms evolve.
